en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a formal rose garden with a central decorative fountain. Large white roses dominate the foreground, in sharp focus, while in the mid‑ground there is a multi-tiered stone fountain with sculptural figures. Behind it are well-kept flowerbeds, hedges, pergolas and trees, and a building partially visible in the distance under a sky with scattered clouds. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.
